title: Conservative Party of Canada — public fundraising / finance snapshot (2024–2025 class)
disclaimer: Figures from published Elections Canada returns and contemporaneous reporting. Not a full contributor network map.

facts.claim: CPC reported record individual donations class ~CAD $48.1–48.3 million for calendar 2025 (party claims + EC-linked reporting).
Prior-year CPC donation record cited ~$41.7M (2024) — 2025 exceeds.
Q4 2025: CPC ~$6.415M from ~42,000 contributions (Writ/EC reporting class).
CPC total revenue 2025 ~$84.6–85M class including government transfers; annual deficit >$14M after election-year spend (CBC on EC audited returns, Jul 2026).
facts.detail: Donations ~$48.3M; government transfers listed ~$32.7M in audit expense tables (breakdown incomplete in secondary reporting)

facts.claim: Liberals 2025 fundraising best-ever party claim ~$29M+ class — still trail CPC on donation volume but gap narrowed post-election quarters.

historical_ec_corpus_note.note: Lifetime corpus totals are multi-year aggregate in site dataset — not 2025-only.

5gw_read.implication: CPC retains superior small-donor machine (21st consecutive year leading under modern rules class) — funds X/video mesh and ground game independent of state media. Election-year deficit shows high burn on contest for narrative/power.
5gw_read.collection_gap: Named top individual donors 2023–2025 still require EC quarterly CSV pull for network graph
